long_biography.plain_text:
Bowen grew up in a small farming community in Missouri and studied chemistry, economics and business administration at Westminster College. He began in corporate sales and marketing, then moved into executive roles and consulting assignments that exposed him to turnarounds, lean operations and global supply chains.

In 2004, Bowen established Maine Pointe with colleagues from earlier ventures. He shaped its Total Value Optimization method and expanded the firm across North America, Europe and Asia. SGS bought a majority stake in 2019 and the remaining company interest four years later. Bowen had already transferred chief-executive duties and moved into an advisory role. His later work has centred on authorship, speaking and leadership guidance.
